description: Land Title Settlement Department - Tumbowa, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District - Cad. Map No. 310092 (24/120055)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various villages in Matale District under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership claims, cadastral maps, and land title settlement procedures, which directly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
